title: Detect Potential Malware Using Packed Executable and DNS C2
id: 1234abcd-5678-efgh-ijkl-9876mnopqrst
status: test
description: |
  Detect processes executing a packed UPX binary that initiates DNS queries to external domains, which may indicate malware with DNS tunneling capabilities.
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'UPX'
  dns_query:
    EventID: 22  # Windows DNS query event
    QueryName|endswith: '.com'
    QueryName|contains: 'evil'
  condition: selection and dns_query
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - QueryName
  - ProcessId
  - ParentProcessId
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate software using UPX packing
level: high
